title: spectrum-settings-panel: the spectrogram «Параметры» panel moves onto the universal @panel control (dockable + detachable, like «Открытие файлов» / «Список треков»), and its parameter groups become blocks laid out as TILES when two fit side by side, or as a single-column ACCORDION when they do not

decisions.text: THIRD consumer of the @panel control; host = AudioPage's shared dock-wrap; the `tune` toolbar button stays in TracksPanel. New stores/spectrum-settings-panel.ts -> usePanelWindowState('spectrum-settings', {defaultMode:'floating', defaultDockSize:320}) with the DEFAULT mindwave-panel-spectrum-settings-* keys — no legacy mapping is needed (unlike file-open, which had to keep mindwave-fs-browser-*), because today's visibility is not persisted at all: it is a plain local ref (TracksPanel.vue:2649). New SpectrumSettingsDialog.vue (PanelWindow wrapper) is hosted in audio-page__dock-wrap next to FileOpenDialog + TrackListDialog (AudioPage.vue:133-151) behind the same <Teleport to="body" :disabled="!floating">. WHY AudioPage and not TracksPanel: PW-D9 was FORCED to host «Список треков» inside TracksPanel because gtracks = useGtrackLanes(...) is a per-call factory and a second host would spawn a second divergent instance — that constraint does NOT apply here, since the spectrogram settings live in a GLOBAL Pinia singleton store (stores/spectrogram.ts:95) that every host shares by construction. What DOES apply is PW-D10: q-tab-panels have no keep-alive, so TracksPanel is destroyed on every tab switch and a panel hosted from there cannot survive one. AudioPage hosting therefore reproduces exactly the behaviour of the two panels the owner named as the model (req 1: «по аналогии»). The `tune` button stays where the owner put it (SF-D5) and toggles panel.open of the shared state: usePanelWindowState is a module-level Map singleton (use-panel-window.ts:119), NOT Pinia, so TracksPanel's toolbar and AudioPage's host reach the same object with zero prop plumbing.

REVISED 2026-07-16 — THE DECISION IS UNCHANGED, ITS JUSTIFICATION IS NOT. Originally the name was held in place by a PROHIBITION: AudioPage.vue:508 still imported the file from the dead GT2.4 island, so renaming would break vue-tsc and drag the owner-deferred WS2.1 cleanup into this feature (R6). Another session has since DELETED that island (GnauralCore 15d1960, 'WS2.1 audio: delete the orphaned pre-GT2.4 tracks island from AudioPage'; WS2.1 is now `done` in the wave-settings-dialog ledger). Re-verified 2026-07-16: the import is gone and exactly ONE consumer imports the file workspace-wide — TracksPanel.vue:1294. So renaming is now POSSIBLE and R6 is closed. The decision nevertheless stands, because it always had a second and stronger leg which is now the only one: this IS the PW5.7 precedent's naming — TrackListView (pure view) / TrackListPanel (IN-WINDOW ADAPTER) / TrackListRemote (child). SpectrogramSettingsPanel is the same in-window adapter and already carries the right name; renaming it now would break step with the only living model, for the sake of renaming. Lesson recorded on purpose: a decision that survives the loss of its stated reason must have the surviving reason written down, or the next session will 'fix' it back.

Split into View + two adapters (the PW5.7 «пульт» shape), file name SpectrogramSettingsPanel.vue PRESERVED. (a) SpectrogramSettingsView.vue — pure view: props = a snapshot (settings, presets, activePresetId, isModified) + layout, emits ONE serializable `action`; ALL block/tile/accordion markup lives here. (b) SpectrogramSettingsPanel.vue — in-window adapter over the store (same path, same name). (c) SpectrogramSettingsRemote.vue — child adapter: renders the parent's snapshot, emits `action` over the bridge, owns NO store and NO persistence. (d) applySpectrumSettingsAction(store, action) — one function applying an action on both sides, so the parent's store stays the single source of truth. (For the superseded 'the name is load-bearing because AudioPage:508 imports it' rationale, see the paragraph above — it was true when written on 2026-07-16 and stopped being true the same day.)

Detach MUST be a «пульт» (PW5.7); the naive per-child-store variant is VERIFIED BROKEN, and it fails WORSE here than it did for «Список треков». Verified 2026-07-16 by grep over GnauralCore/ui stores+composables+components: there is NO 'storage' event listener ANYWHERE, and stores/spectrogram.ts:121-123 persists three keys (mindwave-spectrogram-settings / -user-presets / -active-preset) via deep watches. Consequences for a detached child running its own Pinia (every window is its own JS realm — PW-D11): (a) SILENT NO-OP — the child edits ITS store, so the parent's renderOptions/analysisParams never change and the main window's spectrogram is never repainted, i.e. the panel's entire purpose fails; (b) CLOBBERING — both windows' deep watches write the same 3 keys, last-writer-wins. The asymmetry vs PW-D11 matters and is against us: the naive detached track list showed an EMPTY list — visibly broken, impossible to ship by accident. Here the child would look FULLY functional (the snapshot seeds from localStorage, every control moves) and simply affect nothing. A silent failure is the one that ships. Therefore allowDetach is enabled ONLY together with the remote (phase 3); until then :allow-detach="false" is passed EXPLICITLY (never omitted — see SS-R5 / PW5.7c: an absent type-only Boolean prop casts to false, which is how the mode silently vanished for both existing panels).

The tiles<->accordion switch is driven by CONTENT WIDTH via ResizeObserver, not by CSS. It cannot be pure CSS (@container/media) because the switch is STRUCTURAL: accordion blocks collapse, tiles do not. ResizeObserver on the panel body, guarded by `typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined'` — the convention of all 6 existing call sites (FsEntryList.vue:315-320 — which is itself inside the file-open panel — GTrackView, SpectrogramView, WaveformView, GnauralScheduleView, SpectrogramMinimap). Rule: TILES when contentWidth >= 2*MIN_BLOCK + gap, else ACCORDION (owner req 3/4). Starting MIN_BLOCK = 280px (today's panel is a fixed 300px column and the controls fit it — TracksPanel.vue:3269-3284); the exact value is MEASURED against the real controls in SS2.1 and recorded here. gap = 8px -> threshold ~568px. The tile grid itself is grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr)), so 2 columns at the threshold and 3-4 when wider come for free: req 3 states the CONDITION («два блока»), not a cap (confirm via Q4). Both modes are reachable by construction: minFloatW=460 and defaultDockSize=320 (left/right dock) are below the threshold -> accordion; a top/bottom dock spans the editor width -> tiles.

CONFIRMED by owner req 6 («Несколько сразу, состояние запоминается»). Accordion = q-expansion-item, modelled on GTrackSpectrumSettings.vue:7,40 — the ONLY file in the entire workspace that uses that control, and conveniently a per-lane editor of the very same SpectrogramSettings type. Multiple blocks may be open at once; the open set persists (mindwave-panel-spectrum-settings-groups). Default open = the first block, which after SS-D6 is «Пресеты»; if that reads badly at SS2.2 (it is a one-row block), the default is a one-line change.

REVISED by owner req 5 — the answer was a HYBRID of the two options offered, and both halves carry weight: «Пресеты - отдельный блок. Кнопка Сброс сама по себе отдельно в футере». (a) PRESETS ARE A FIFTH BLOCK, first in order — a tile in the tiled layout, a collapsible item in the accordion — holding today's preset bar (SpectrogramSettingsPanel.vue:3-34: dropdown with ✓active and *modified, «Сохранить как…», «Управление…»). (b) «Сброс» (:105-107) is NOT inside that block: it goes into PanelWindow's `footer` slot (PanelWindow.vue:46-47) «сам по себе». The distinction is functional, not cosmetic, and it is why the offered 'presets are a fifth block' option was not accepted wholesale: had «Сброс» lived inside the presets block, collapsing that block in the accordion would have hidden Reset too. In the footer it is always visible and never collapses. CONSEQUENCE for req 3: five blocks, not four — with auto-fill the last tile row is always partial (see R2). CONSEQUENCE for SS-D2: «Пресеты» is an ordinary View block, so preset gestures emit the SAME serializable `action` as field edits — no second channel.

i18n: no new title key needed. The PanelWindow title and the manifest titleKey both reuse the EXISTING audio.spectrogramSettingsTitle («Параметры» / "Parameters", SF-D4) — it is already exactly this panel's caption; icon `tune`, the same as the toolbar button. Dock/detach menu labels are already generic and translated (panel.dockMenu/dockFloat/dockLeft/dockRight/dockTop/dockBottom/detach/close in MindWaveCore/ui/src/i18n/locales/{ru,en}.json). New keys only if Q1/Q2 introduce new captions.

REVISED by owner req 7 («Применить + «Сохранить как…»») — the detached child gets preset APPLY + «Сохранить как…»; «Управление…» stays main-window-only. Both permitted operations decompose into 'local input + one bridged action': apply emits an action directly; «Сохранить как…» runs its $q.dialog prompt child-side (a prompt is UI, and UI is local) and then bridges an action carrying the chosen name. The child still owns no store and no persistence (SS-D3). SpectrogramPresetManager.vue (rename/delete/duplicate/EXPORT/IMPORT) does NOT travel to the child, which removes the dirtiest part of phase 3: file export/import over the bridge. Implementation = an `allowPresetManage` prop on the View, declared via withDefaults with default TRUE — the main window passes nothing, SpectrogramSettingsRemote passes false to hide «Управление…». withDefaults is mandatory rather than a bare type-only boolean: an ABSENT type-only Boolean prop is cast by Vue to false (R5 / WS-D6 / PW5.7c — the exact trap that silently hid the detach mode from BOTH existing panels), so a bare prop here would silently hide «Управление…» in the MAIN window too.

SS-D1 (host = AudioPage) and SS-D3 (detach only as a remote) drew no objection
evidence: Every claim in the plan was verified by reading the code, not inferred from shape — this repo has already punished shape-based reasoning twice in the wave-settings ledger (a localStorage key claimed shared that was not, and a watch claimed dangerous that could not fire).

THE FIND THAT SHAPES THE WHOLE FEATURE (SS-D3): grep for a 'storage' event listener across GnauralCore/ui stores+composables+components returns NOTHING. So a naive detached child with its own Pinia would edit its own store, never repaint the parent's spectrogram, and — via the deep watches at stores/spectrogram.ts:121-123 — race the parent on the same 3 localStorage keys. Crucially the failure is INVISIBLE (the child seeds from localStorage and looks fully alive), unlike PW-D11's empty track list, which advertised its own brokenness. That is why detach is phased behind the PW5.7 remote instead of shipped naively.

THE FIND THAT SHAPED THE FILE LAYOUT (SS-D2/R6) — SUPERSEDED THE SAME DAY, see the 2026-07-16 re-check log entry: at authoring time AudioPage.vue:508 still imported SpectrogramSettingsPanel.vue from the dead GT2.4 island (template ended :426, never rendered it — inert at runtime, live to vue-tsc), which forbade renaming the file. Another session then landed WS2.1 (GnauralCore 15d1960) and deleted the island; the import is gone, R6 is closed, and SS-D2 now rests on the PW5.7 naming precedent instead. Left here as-written rather than rewritten, because it WAS the reason at the time and the ledger records what was known when.

THE FIND THAT MAKES req 2 CHEAP: the panel is data-driven, not markup-driven — the groups are a computed<Group[]> (SpectrogramSettingsPanel.vue:229-280) rendered by ONE v-for (:37). 'Every group becomes a block' is therefore a change to one v-for plus CSS, not a rewrite of 17 fields. The four groups (Масштаб 3 / Цвет 7 / FFT-фильтр 5 / Резкость 4 fields) are SF-D35 + SF-D51 and are exactly what the owner calls «группы параметров».

PLACEMENT is not a coin flip (SS-D1): PW-D9 hosted «Список треков» inside TracksPanel only because gtracks is a per-call factory; our state is a global Pinia singleton, so that constraint is absent, while PW-D10 (no keep-alive on q-tab-panels -> TracksPanel dies on tab switch) still applies. AudioPage hosting is what makes 'по аналогии с Открытием файлов и Списком треков' literally true.

PRECEDENT FOUND FOR THE CLEANUP SS1.1 MUST DO: TracksPanel.vue:2921-2922 records that when «Список треков» became a PanelWindow it stopped using the --tp-* scroll-frame pinning, because PanelWindow owns its positioning. Our panel must leave anyOverlayOpen (:2923) for the same reason — the precedent already walked this path.

Also confirmed first-hand: PanelWindow's props/emits/slots (PanelWindow.vue:68-89, footer slot at :46-47, minFloatW=460), the panel registry being a module manifest and not an enum/switch (GnauralCore/ui/module.ts:20-38 -> modules/index.ts:40 -> PanelHostPage.vue:33), the panel-state singleton being a module-level Map rather than Pinia (use-panel-window.ts:119), q-expansion-item existing in exactly one file (GTrackSpectrumSettings.vue), and all 6 ResizeObserver sites guarding on `typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined'`.
Step ids use the SS prefix: AP/FB/BK/GT/R/MR/PW/PR/SF/SB/TT/RF/WS are taken by the 11 existing ledgers (SF = spectrogram-fixes, which owns this panel's history and stays untouched).

NOT decided by me, deliberately: Q1-Q4 (§7) were put to the owner rather than settled by proposal. That paid off on Q1: the answer («Пресеты - отдельный блок. Кнопка Сброс сама по себе отдельно в футере») was a HYBRID that neither offered option contained, and the half I would have gotten wrong is the load-bearing one — with «Сброс» inside the presets block, collapsing that block in the accordion would have hidden Reset. R2/R3 remain visual calls for the SS2.2/SS1.2 PAUSEs, since no browser driver exists in this workspace (verified in WS1.1).

Owner answers folded back into both documents the same day: SS-D6 and SS-D8 rewritten as REVISED (with the reason the hybrid differs from either option, so a future session does not 'simplify' Reset back into the presets block), SS-D4/SS-D5 marked confirmed, plan §7 turned from a question list into a closed-questions table, R2 strengthened (five blocks, not four -> the tile grid's last row is always partial and «Пресеты» is a 1-row block against «Цвет»'s 7 fields), and SS2.1/SS3.2 re-scoped.

log.text:
RE-CHECK after the owner reported that another session deleted the dead island (GnauralCore 15d1960 «WS2.1 audio: delete the orphaned pre-GT2.4 tracks island from AudioPage»; WS2.1 is now `done` in the wave-settings-dialog ledger). The plan changes in one decision's REASONING, one risk closes, and SS1.1 gains a small deletion. Implementation still not started.

WHAT I RE-VERIFIED RATHER THAN ASSUMED — every line citation in the plan, because another session's commits move line numbers and a plan citing wrong lines is exactly the «дезинформация» WS §8 warns about. Result: TracksPanel, SpectrogramSettingsPanel, stores/spectrogram.ts, the @panel control, module.ts and both consumer examples are ALL still accurate to the line — that session touched only AudioPage. Even the two AudioPage citations the plan still needs (dock-wrap :133-151, template end :426) survive.

WHAT CHANGED: (1) R6 is CLOSED — the import at AudioPage:508 is gone and exactly one consumer imports the file workspace-wide (TracksPanel.vue:1294), so renaming SpectrogramSettingsPanel.vue is now possible and breaks nothing. (2) SS-D2 is REVISED but NOT reversed: it keeps the name because that is the PW5.7 precedent's naming (TrackListPanel is likewise the in-window adapter) — the leg it always had, and now the only one. A decision whose stated reason evaporates must have its surviving reason written down, or a later session 'fixes' it back; that is why SS-D2 now spells this out instead of quietly still saying 'preserved'.

WHAT THE CLEANUP DID NOT TAKE (found by re-checking, not reported): WS2.1 removed the TRACKS island, but the AudioPage residue belonging to OUR panel survived it — spectrogramSettingsOpen + closeSpectrogramSettings (:1000-1005), an Escape branch (:1156-1161) inside the LIVE handlePlayerKeyDown (registered :1384), and the overlay CSS (~:1689-1752). All three are provably dead rather than presumed: the ref is only declared and set to false — no toggle survives — so the Escape guard is permanently false, and the CSS classes appear nowhere in the template (ends :426). I also checked the trap that would have made deleting them dangerous: both <style> blocks are `scoped` (AudioPage :1428, TracksPanel :2969), so AudioPage's rules never styled TracksPanel's live aside — the two copies are independent. SS1.1 therefore widens to delete this residue: the old rule 'do not touch AudioPage, WS2.1 is deferred' no longer exists, and leaving a dead Escape guard + dead CSS for a panel that no longer exists in that shape anywhere would recreate, in miniature, the very island that was just removed.

SS0.1 PAUSE passed — owner answered Q1-Q4 (plan §1 req 5-8; §7 is now a closed-questions table). Two decisions REVISED, two confirmed; implementation still not started, SS1.1 is next.

Q1 is the one worth recording, because the answer was a HYBRID of the two options offered and NEITHER was right: «Пресеты - отдельный блок. Кнопка Сброс сама по себе отдельно в футере». I had offered (a) presets as a strip + Reset in the footer, or (b) presets as a fifth block with Reset inside it. The owner took the block from (b) and the footer from (a) — and that combination is not cosmetic: had «Сброс» lived inside the presets block, collapsing that block in the accordion would have hidden Reset with it. In the footer it is always visible and never collapses. SS-D6 now records that reason explicitly, so a later session does not 'tidy' Reset back into the block it visually belongs to.

Consequences folded through both documents rather than left implicit: five blocks instead of four means the tile grid's last row is always partial and the height spread grows («Пресеты» = 1 row vs «Цвет» = 7 fields) -> R2 strengthened, with 'presets full-width on the first row' noted as a fallback for SS2.2; «Пресеты» being an ordinary View block means preset gestures ride the SAME serializable `action` as field edits (SS-D2), so no second bridge channel is needed.

Q3 («Применить + «Сохранить как…»») shrinks SS3.2 usefully: the child never needs file export/import over the bridge — the dirtiest part of the remote. It becomes an allowPresetManage prop, and it MUST be declared via withDefaults(default true): an absent type-only Boolean casts to false in Vue (WS-D6 / PW5.7c — the trap that already hid the detach mode from both existing panels), so a bare prop would hide «Управление…» in the MAIN window too. That check is written into SS3.2's verify rather than trusted to memory.

Q2 (multi-open + persisted) and Q4 (tiles from ~568px, 3-4 columns wider) confirmed as proposed — SS-D5/SS-D4 unchanged apart from being marked confirmed.

Plan + ledger created (owner req 2026-07-16): the spectrogram settings panel moves onto the dockable/detachable @panel control «по аналогии» with «Открытие файлов» / «Список треков», and its parameter groups become blocks — tiles when two fit side by side, a single-column accordion when they do not.

The inventory turned three facts into the plan's spine, each verified by reading code rather than inferred:

1. DETACH CANNOT BE NAIVE, AND FAILS SILENTLY IF IT IS (SS-D3). There is no 'storage' event listener anywhere in GnauralCore/ui, and stores/spectrogram.ts:121-123 deep-watches three localStorage keys. A detached child with its own Pinia (every window is its own JS realm — PW-D11) would edit its own store, never repaint the PARENT's spectrogram, and race the parent on the same keys. The asymmetry vs PW-D11 is what matters: the naive detached track list showed an EMPTY list and advertised its brokenness; this panel would look perfectly alive and simply do nothing. Silent failures are the ones that ship, so detach is phased behind the PW5.7 remote («пульт»), with :allow-detach="false" passed EXPLICITLY until then (absent type-only Boolean casts to false — the PW5.7c trap that already hid the mode from both existing panels).

2. THE FILE MAY NOT BE RENAMED (SS-D2/R6). AudioPage.vue:508 still imports SpectrogramSettingsPanel.vue from the dead GT2.4 island; the template (ends :426) never renders it, so it is inert at runtime but live to vue-tsc. Renaming would break typecheck and drag WS2.1 — a cleanup the OWNER DEFERRED — into this feature. So the new file is …View.vue; the old name keeps its path and becomes the in-window adapter.

3. req 2 IS CHEAP, BECAUSE THE PANEL IS DATA-DRIVEN. The groups are a computed<Group[]> (:229-280) rendered by ONE v-for (:37) — 'every group becomes a block' is one v-for + CSS, not 17 fields rewritten.

Hosting is likewise not a coin flip: PW-D9 kept «Список треков» inside TracksPanel only because gtracks is a per-call factory; our store is a global Pinia singleton, so that constraint is gone, while PW-D10 (no keep-alive -> TracksPanel dies on tab switch) still applies -> host in AudioPage's shared dock-wrap, which is what makes «по аналогии» literally true. And TracksPanel.vue:2921-2922 already records the cleanup SS1.1 owes: a PanelWindow owns its positioning, so the panel must leave anyOverlayOpen/--tp-*, exactly as PW5.2 did.

The tiles<->accordion switch needs JS (ResizeObserver, guarded like all 6 existing sites), because it is STRUCTURAL — accordion blocks collapse, tiles do not — so CSS @container cannot express it. Its real risk is not the threshold but FLAPPING at it: collapsed accordion -> no scrollbar -> wider -> tiles -> taller -> scrollbar -> narrower -> accordion (R1); mitigated by measuring a container whose width does not depend on content, scrollbar-gutter: stable, and hysteresis if needed.

Four questions are left OPEN for the owner rather than silently decided (§7): Q1 presets/«Сброс» — strip+footer or a fifth block; Q2 accordion — multi-open+persisted or exactly one; Q3 detached preset manager — full or apply+save-as only (this one materially sizes SS3.2); Q4 the tile threshold and 3-4 columns on a wide dock. Implementation not started — owner review of the plan, then SS1.1.
